facts.function: transmits power from the PTO/drive to the spinner discs, changing speed and/or direction at a fixed ratio

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 8483 names gear boxes and other speed changers

GRI 6: 8483.40 gear boxes and speed changers; fixed ratio speed changers ... selected by manual manipulation; 8483.40.50 other (not for paper machinery); suffix .10 fixed ratio speed changers (assumed fixed-ratio spreader gearbox)

rejected_alternatives.reason: Section XVI note 2(a) sends goods of heading 8483 to their own heading even when they are dedicated spreader parts; H348950 used 8432.90 only for components that are not goods of a specific heading
other speed changers (e.g., automatically variable); a spreader gearbox is a fixed-ratio unit

missing_facts: Is the gearbox fixed-ratio (assumed) or multiple/variable ratio?
classification.rationale: A gearbox assembly is a 'gear box or other speed changer' named in heading 8483, and Section XVI note 2(a) keeps such a good in its own heading even when made for fertilizer spreaders. Spreader gearboxes are fixed-ratio bevel-gear units, so the line is 8483.40.50.10. NY N355530 (in force) classified a fixed 1:1 ratio bevel gearbox for a specific machine application in 8483.40.5010.
